title: Social fear memory as a framework for understanding social defeat stress and psychopathology
title_zh: 社会恐惧记忆：用于理解社会挫败应激与精神病理的框架
abstract: Social defeat is a potent stressor in both rodents and humans that, under conditions of chronic or severe stress, can lead to persistent social avoidance. This review synthesizes evidence supporting the view that social defeat promotes the formation of social fear memory through associative learning mechanisms that parallel classical fear conditioning. Drawing on preclinical models, we describe how the context of social defeat functions as a conditioned stimulus, while the experience of defeat serves as an unconditioned stimulus, giving rise to fear-related behaviors such as freezing and social avoidance. The consolidation and expression of social fear memory rely on distributed neural circuits that integrate threat appraisal, contextual processing, and social information. These include canonical fear-related regions such as the amygdala and medial prefrontal cortex, as well as socially specialized structures, including the nucleus accumbens. These circuits are further modulated by neuroendocrine systems, including stress hormones, norepinephrine, oxytocin, vasopressin, and orexin, which shape fear memory processes in a context-dependent manner. Finally, we discuss how conceptualizing social defeat-induced learning as social fear memory provides a mechanistic framework for understanding social stress-related psychopathology and identifying targets for intervention across phases of fear memory processing, from acquisition to extinction. This perspective may inform the refinement of pharmacological and psychological treatments for stress-related disorders with a social component.
abstract_zh: 社会挫败是啮齿类动物和人类中一种强烈应激源，在慢性或强度较高应激条件下可导致持续的社会回避。该综述整合了证据，支持这样一种观点：社会挫败通过与经典条件性恐惧相平行的联结学习机制促进社会恐惧记忆的形成。基于前临床模型，我们描述了社会挫败的情境如何作为条件刺激，而挫败经历本身作为非条件刺激，进而引发恐惧相关行为，如僵直与社会回避。社会恐惧记忆的巩固与表达依赖分布式神经环路，这些环路整合威胁评估、情境处理和社会信息，包括杏仁核与内侧前额叶皮层等经典恐惧相关区域，以及核仁（壳核）等社会化专门结构。神经内分泌系统进一步调节这些环路，包括应激激素、去甲肾上腺素、催产素、催产素?（文中为vasopressin，保留为“加压素”）和orexin，这些系统以情境依赖方式塑造恐惧记忆过程。最后，我们讨论将社会挫败诱发的学习概念化为社会恐惧记忆如何为理解社会应激相关精神病理及干预靶点识别提供机制框架，覆盖从记忆形成到消退的各个处理阶段。该视角可用于优化针对具有社会成分的应激相关障碍的药物和心理治疗。
